messages:
alice_acme: Hey team — after the 3/15 rollout (v2026-03-15-rc3) our integration is seeing function/tool calls either omitted or with wrong argument names. This started around 09:12 UTC yesterday. Example attached below.

jordan_support: Sorry about that — can you share the raw request you sent and the API response (full JSON)? Also which model and route are you hitting?

alice_acme: Sure — sending anonymized payload. We're calling the hosted chat endpoint with a function spec.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{\n    "model": "redwood-chat-1",\n    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"price for product 123 in us-east"}],\n    "functions": [{"name":"price_lookup","parameters":{\n       "type":"object",\n       "properties":{\n         "product_id":{"type":"string"},\n         "region":{"type":"string"}\n       },\n       "required":["product_id"]\n    }}],\n    "function_call": "auto"\n  }'\n```

alice_acme: The expected function call: {"name":"price_lookup","arguments":{"product_id":"123","region":"us-east"}}
But recent responses are either: 1) no function call at all, just text; or 2) function call with args renamed: {"name":"price_lookup","arguments":{"productId":"123"}} (note camelCase) — our parser then fails.

maya_sre: @jordan_support fyi deploy-bot shows rollout v2026-03-15-rc3 pushed a model variant with schema-inference tweaks. Canary at 25% for a few hours yesterday.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout v2026-03-15-rc3: model=redwood-chat-1 variant=b29c, canary=25%, started=2026-03-15T08:45:12Z, status=completed

eli_research: Can you paste the raw assistant output (JSON) for one of the bad requests? Need to confirm whether model emitted a different function name or changed schema formatting.

alice_acme: Pasting raw assistant response (redacted content):
```
{"id":"resp-9a1b","object":"assistant_response","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"price_lookup","arguments":"{\\\"productId\\\":\\\"123\\\"}"}} ,{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Price is $9.99"}}]}
```

jordan_support: Looks like two problems: the assistant sometimes returns a plain text message instead of a function_call object; when it does function_call, arguments string uses camelCase keys rather than snake_case. That explains your parser breakage.

maya_sre: Could be the variant switched to a newer schema-inference layer that serializes generated JSON differently. We rolled a lane that tries to be permissive with key normalization — apparently too permissive.

eli_research: Quick repro idea: force model=redwood-chat-1@stable (previous model digest) and see if behavior returns to normal. Also please forward 2 example request_ids for our logs.

alice_acme: Request ids: req_20260315_09_12_41 and req_20260315_10_03_07. We're in a live checkout flow so this broke many transactions.

jordan_support: Thanks. Escalating to eng-ml and runtime. Short-term workaround: set "function_call": {"name":"price_lookup"} to force explicit function selection, and add tolerant parsing that accepts camelCase keys. We'll share a quick patch for your SDK.

eli_research: For platform action: rolling back variant b29c on the affected fleet is an option but will reduce canary metrics. @maya_sre can you confirm rollback feasibility?

maya_sre: We can rollback the variant immediately for the region US-EAST-1 for customer traffic if legal. Will coordinate with infra; pinging eng-releases.

jordan_support: @alice_acme I'm adding you to a short bridge with eng-ml to validate fixes. Temporary ETA for workaround SDK patch: ~2 hours. Platform rollback ETA (if approved): ~30–60 minutes.

alice_acme: Appreciate it. Please prioritize rollback — this impacts checkout conversion. Also would like a postmortem on why schema normalization changed without a compatibility guard.

jordan_support: Understood. Creating incident and tagging postmortem owners. We'll update here when rollback or fix is live. :eyes:

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollback initiated for variant b29c in region us-east-1 by maya_sre at 2026-03-16T11:05:02Z

maya_sre: Rollback completed for us-east-1; canary traffic now back to stable. Monitoring for errors.

jordan_support: @alice_acme can you confirm whether new requests in us-east are fixed for you?

alice_acme: Confirmed — after rollback function calls are back to expected snake_case args and no silent text-only responses so far. Thank you.

eli_research: We'll follow up with a root-cause and a compatibility guard for schema serialization. Leaving this thread open until postmortem posted.

jordan_support: Closing loop: incident created INC-2026-452, mitigation=rollback, customer workaround=explicit function_call + tolerant parser, next steps=postmortem by eng-ml.

alice_acme: Thanks all.
